label: Makers of a contingent fact are contingent by modal failure transport (inference)
rule: Use world immanence for actual existence and existing failure_transport for accessible nonexistence
meaning: Reuses PSRStrength.failure_transport: a falsifying accessible world for the fact cannot contain a necessitating maker of that fact. Every such maker is actual and possibly absent. Only a necessary condition for makers is established. RootClosure.necessaryFactAnyMaker already shows why weak maker necessitation cannot infer necessity or relevance of a maker of a necessary fact.
